# Rectifia

> Rectifia is a workplace misconduct reporting and HR case management platform. It gives employees a reporting channel they trust (anonymous or confidential, no login required) and gives HR and compliance teams an investigation workflow that keeps outcomes consistent across every case, department, and investigator.

## What Rectifia does

- **Reporting channel**: Employees file reports anonymously (no identity ever stored) or confidentially, with no login required.
- **Severity & evidence scoring**: AI scores severity and evidence completeness separately and routes cases to the right handler. AI never decides guilt, recommends discipline, or closes a case - that stays with human investigators.
- **Consistency & Bias Engine**: Before a case closes, the proposed action is checked against similar closed cases (same category, comparable severity and evidence) to catch cases where two similar situations would otherwise get different outcomes.
- **Compliance deadline tracking**: Acknowledgment and feedback clocks (e.g. the EU Whistleblower Directive's 7-day acknowledgment and 3-month feedback deadlines) are computed per jurisdiction and shown on every case.
- **Role-based access**: HR sees case status and category. Handlers see only cases assigned to them. Company Admin has zero access to case content by design.

## Pricing

Rectifia bills by employee headcount, never per report or per submission, specifically to avoid creating an incentive to suppress reporting.

- Starter: up to 25 employees, $59/mo
- Growth: 26-200 employees, $199/mo
- Scale: 201-500 employees, $549/mo
- Enterprise: 500+ employees, contact sales

## Compliance posture

Rectifia is built to align with the EU Whistleblower Directive (2019/1937). Rectifia does not yet hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification (on the roadmap) - if that is a hard procurement requirement today, Rectifia is not yet the right fit.

## Jurisdictions

Rectifia computes reporting deadlines and obligations per jurisdiction:

- EU Whistleblower Directive: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/eu-whistleblower-directive-compliance-software - 7-day acknowledgment and 3-month feedback clocks
- UK PIDA: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/uk-whistleblowing-software-pida-compliance
- Australia Respect@Work positive duty: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/australia-respect-at-work-positive-duty-software
- Japan Whistleblower Protection Act: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/japan-whistleblower-protection-act-compliance - designated handler (従事者) register for companies with 300+ employees; covers the 2025 amendments in force from 1 December 2026
- Japan, in Japanese (日本語): https://rectifia.com/ja/naibu-tsuho-system - 公益通報者保護法対応の内部通報システム
- US SOX reporting hotline: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/us-sox-compliance-reporting-hotline
- Kenya: https://rectifia.com/jurisdictions/kenya-workplace-misconduct-reporting

## Who Rectifia is for

Rectifia is built for HR and compliance teams that investigate cases, not only collect reports. Organisations under roughly 300 employees that mainly need a simple anonymous reporting channel are usually better served by VoxWel (https://voxwel.com), Rectifia's sister product from Lumora Ventures.

- Whistleblower hotline software: https://rectifia.com/whistleblower-hotline-software - anonymous reporting with Case ID and passcode, AI-assisted intake, deadline tracking
- Employee relations case management software: https://rectifia.com/employee-relations-case-management-software - case management for complaints in four categories (harassment, toxic management, retaliation, burnout), with a consistency check across past cases
- Workplace investigation software: https://rectifia.com/workplace-investigation-software - report to closed case with AI-assisted intake and routing, human decisions and deadline tracking
